We remand to the trial court to amend its commitment orders to reflect that it sentenced Rosales-Silva to three years for count 1 and one year for count 5, to be served consecutively; to one year for count 2; to one year for count 3; to eight months for count 4; to eight months for count 6; and to one year for count 7. The orders shall also reflect that the sentences for counts 2, 3, 4, 6, and 7 are to be served concurrently to the sentences for counts 1 and 5.  The orders shall therefore reflect that the sentences for counts 2, 3, 4, 6, and 7 are fully served due to the 548 days of credit he received for his time served in county jail, and that he is not subject to mandatory supervision for them.   In all other respects, the judgment is affirmed.
